# XEAtoy — Wholesale Squishy & Fidget Toy Factory (Jinhua, Zhejiang, China)
> Direct China manufacturer of wholesale squishy toys, bead-free stress balls, and 26-key LED fidget keyboards. 150+ ready-to-ship CPC-certified stock SKUs, 1-carton trial MOQ (24-144 pcs), ASTM F963-23, CPSIA, and EN71 compliant.

## Core Wholesale Collections
- [All 150 Stock Wholesale SKUs](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/): Interactive factory catalog across TPR, Silicone, Gel, Slushie, Dough, and Fidget Keyboards.
- [26-Key LED Fidget Keyboards](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/fidget-keyboards/): 26-LED, 10-LED, and Non-LED mechanical clicker keyboards (120-144 pcs/ctn, CPC certified).
- [Crystal Clear Gel, Glitter & Slushie Stress Balls](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/crystal-gel-slushie-stress-balls/): 39 bead-free crystal gel, pearl gel, rose cube, and crushed-ice slushie SKUs.
- [Jumbo Flour Dough, Highland Cow & Axolotl Squishies](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/jumbo-dough-squishies/): 350g-400g oversized dough toys, clownfish blind boxes, and Christmas/Halloween seasonal dogs.
- [Crunchy Building Block TPR Squishies](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/crunchy-building-block-squishies/): 56+ ASMR crunchy block shapes including butter bars, cheese, and viral animals.
- [Taba & Platinum Silicone Squishies](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/taba-silicone-squishies/): Soft food-grade silicone cat paw and creamy squishy wholesale.
- [Slow-Rising PU & Maltose Stress Balls](https://epic-sienna-wren-23.hostingersite.com/products/slow-rising-stress-balls/): 100% water-bead-free slow-rebound stress balls.
